steps.message: Fetched 206 live source records; 0 feeds reported failure.
Separate Codex checker decisions bound to exact draft and evidence hashes.

Assessed eight concrete selected ecommerce requests; proposed no posts because all bounded experiments lack relevant attached implementation support and score below the 6/10 threshold. One near-identical shipping-threshold notice was excluded as a repeated task. Recent online-shop support inbox posts also make generic inbox handling a duplicate workflow/customer dimension.

usage.caveat: Token-based standard-rate estimate, not an invoice. Long-context, service-tier, region, paid-tool, and unreported cache-write adjustments are not established by CLI totals. Missing job usage leaves totals unknown; observedCounts covers only reported jobs.

checkedAssessment.reason: No posts were proposed. I examined all ten fresh candidate notices and independent primary fetches: seven describe bounded WooCommerce chores but lack attached implementation evidence, two excerpts do not establish a concrete task, and one repeats the free-shipping threshold issue. The bounded mock experiments remain below the frozen 6/10 threshold; none is a supported candidate.
